TXT_CODE_DSERVER_IP_TIP: Useful on a host with several addresses. Leave it empty to listen on all of them.
TXT_CODE_DSERVER_PATH_TIP: Absolute, or relative to the daemon directory.
TXT_CODE_DSERVER_PORT_TIP: The port the panel connects to. Applied when the daemon starts, so a change needs a restart.
TXT_CODE_DSERVER_PREFIX_TIP: Serve the daemon under a sub-path, for example /daemon. Leave it empty to serve from the root.
TXT_CODE_DSERVER_SSL_TIP: Serve over HTTPS and WSS using the certificate below. Both files are required.
